newsitem.title: UK: SocGen's Harnett to join NatWest Markets.
newsitem.headline: SocGen's Harnett to join NatWest Markets.

text.p: NatWest Markets, the investment banking arm of National Westmister Bank, said Ian Harnett was to join the company's European equity resarch team as Director for European Strategy.
Harnett is currently UK Group Chief Economist at Societe Generale and will take up his new job on November 1.
He has previously worked for ANZ McCaughan as chief economist and at the Bank of England.
Harnett will cover the major equity markets in continental Europe and will report to David Atkinson, head of pan-European equity research. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
